title: The Mist Age - Alchemy
description: Potion crafting for Daggerheart: the GM keeps a book of recipes and chooses which recipes each character knows. A character brews a known potion by putting its ingredients and a vessel (a vial, a bottle) into the alchemy window and making a Knowledge action roll against the recipe's difficulty.

recommends.reason: Unidentified potions: a brewed potion can stay a mystery until the character recognises it.
The GM's alchemy panel shows each character's learn projects next to their recipes.
